About Boulder Culture

About Boulder Culture.

Boulder Culture is a way to meet people in Boulder. Find a local event, try something new, and go even if none of your friends can make it.

Why I started this.

It can be hard to meet people when you don’t already know someone. I started Boulder Culture to make it easier to find things to do and people to do them with.

For now, I’m sharing local events and planning our first gatherings. You don’t need a membership or a friend to bring.

What’s happening now.

Start with Trident’s language exchange and Sunday performances. These are Trident events; each listing links to its calendar.

Boulder Culture’s own hikes, car meets and yoga sessions are still being planned. We’ll post dates and locations once they’re confirmed.

The founder

Founded by Leo Helzberg.

Get in touch with Leo at leo@boulderculture.org.

The foundation

Boulder Culture Foundation is forming in Colorado and is not yet a 501(c)(3). This site does not accept donations. Boulder Culture is independent of CU Boulder and is not a campus club or political campaign.
